title: Contract Pricing Agreement Rebate Ledger: Return Clawback Entries
content:
## Return clawback entries on the Contract Pricing Agreement rebate ledger

**The rule.** On a Contract Pricing Agreement whose tier claws back volume rebate on returns, this policy books the rebate clawback for one return — the customer's most recently received return — against the agreement's latest accrued rebate period. For a return this policy books, and only for such a return, the clawback is worked out under this policy; every other return credited after its period's rebate was accrued is still reduced by the returned merchandise value times the rate originally applied to that period, rounded half up to the cent, booked once per RMA. A return outside this policy's scope carries no clawback under it.

**What the booking does.** A clawback entry is one reversal line on the agreement's rebate ledger for the return material authorization (RMA) named, against the rebate period named. The line carries the merchandise value returned (shown as negative qualifying spend), the rebate rate applied and the rebate amount reversed, is dated on the day it is booked, and the agreement's unpaid rebate balance falls by the amount reversed. The customer sees the clawback on the agreement's rebate statement.

### Invocation

The booking is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_rebate_return_clawback_ccd0c1e2` and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `pricing_agreement_id` | Reference number of the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement, read from the pricing agreement lookup | Id |
| `rebate_period` | Calendar-quarter rebate period the clawback is booked against | YYYY-Qn: four-digit year, a hyphen, the letter Q and the quarter digit 1 to 4 |
| `rma_number` | Return material authorization number exactly as the customer's return records show it | Copied character for character |
| `returned_merchandise_value` | Merchandise value returned that the clawback is worked out on | Positive figure in USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; recorded on the ledger line with its sign reversed |
| `rebate_rate_pct` | Rebate rate applied to that value | Percent, 2 decimal places (percentage points, not a fraction) |
| `amount` | Rebate amount reversed | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded half up to the cent |

### Return

On success the tool returns: `status` ("booked" when the reversal line was written), `rebate_line_id` (reference number of the new rebate ledger line), `rebate_period` (YYYY-Qn), `source_reference` (the RMA number recorded), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places, the rebate reversed) and `rebate_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places, the agreement's unpaid rebate balance once the reversal is booked).
